items.definition:
a network of lines
The city's streets are laid out on a grid pattern.

an exclusive right granted for an invention
He applied for a patent for his new invention.

the ability to see, hear, or become aware of something
His perception of the situation was very different from mine.

a medical doctor
The physician advised him to rest.

an event or a series of activities
The legal proceedings are expected to last for several months.

a type of gun
The hunter carried a rifle.

a competitor
He faced his main rival in the final match.

importance
The discovery has great significance for medical research.

a set of rooms; a set of related items
We booked a suite at the hotel for our vacation.

a person who defeats an opponent
The victor raised his arms in triumph.

the flying or operating of aircraft
He works in the aviation industry.

a metabolic disease
She manages her diabetes with diet and exercise.

a category of artistic composition
My favorite music genre is jazz.

a contract by which one conveys land, property, services, etc., to another for a specified time, usually in return for a periodic payment
They signed a five-year lease on the apartment.

a conception of or belief about something
He had a strange notion that he was being watched.

an action or event regarded as morally or legally wrong and causing general public outrage
The politician was involved in a financial scandal.

an action or strategy carefully planned to achieve a specific end
Their new marketing tactic proved very effective.

gambling establishment
We visited a large casino in Las Vegas.

advice; lawyer
The lawyer offered sound counsel to his client.

firmness of purpose
Her determination to succeed was inspiring.

symbol; revered person
The pop star became a cultural icon.

act of installing; something installed
The installation of the new software took an hour.

a wonderful thing
The Grand Canyon is a natural marvel.

ideal place; heaven
The island felt like a tropical paradise.

first performance
The movie's premiere was held in Hollywood.

office of president
His presidency lasted for four years.

comment; statement
He made a positive remark about her work.

fulfillment of a desire or need
She found great satisfaction in helping others.

an elected officer in a county, responsible for keeping the peace
The sheriff investigated the mysterious disappearance.

a row or level of a structure
The stadium has three tiers of seating.

a fence or other obstacle that prevents movement or access
The language barrier made communication difficult.

an agreement or a settlement of a dispute that is reached by each side making concessions
They reached a compromise after a long discussion.

a homosexual woman
She identifies as a lesbian.

average standard; equal value
He shot two strokes under par on the last hole.

collection of works or investments
She showed her art portfolio to the gallery owner.

the state of being productive
New software can help improve team productivity.

set of rules or procedures
The scientists followed a strict protocol for the experiment.

a share or interest; a pointed stick
The company has a financial stake in the new project.

pressure; injury; type
He pulled a muscle and suffered a leg strain.

an act of breaking a rule or law
Parking here is a violation of the rules.

compulsive need for something
He is trying to overcome his addiction to sugar.

a firm belief; a formal declaration of guilt
He spoke with great conviction about his beliefs.

the length of time something lasts
The duration of the flight was six hours.

a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money
High inflation is a concern for the economy.

a careful examination or review
The house passed its final inspection.

the quality of being intense
The intensity of the storm surprised everyone.

a complete list of items
The store conducted an inventory check at the end of the month.

seasonal movement of animals or people
The annual bird migration is a spectacular sight.

an object propelled to hit a distant target
The missile was launched from the submarine.

a group of people or vehicles that patrol an area
The police patrol maintains order in the city.

a person of the same age, status, or ability as another
Children often learn a lot from their peers.

provision
The contract includes a provision for early termination.

rod
He used a fishing rod to catch the fish.

tattoo
She got a new tattoo on her arm.

tragedy
The accident was a terrible tragedy.

activist
She is a well-known environmental activist.

availability
Please check the availability of the product.

companion
He was a loyal companion on the journey.

consultant
She works as a business consultant.

controller
The air traffic controller guided the plane.

courtesy
He showed great courtesy to his guests.

embassy
We visited the American embassy in London.

goodness
She always tries to see the goodness in people.

guilt
He felt a strong sense of guilt after lying.
